title: Billing Manual — Prorating Fixed Charges in a Utility Pass-Through Service Final-Statement Quote
content:
**Rule.** In quoting the estimated final Utility Pass-Through Service statement for a prepayment, when the days from the latest water read to the service end date are fewer than 15, the fixed charges quoted for the final cycle are the fixed charges billed on the latest statement times those days divided by the days in the read cycle that statement billed; when those days are 15 to 29, they are the fixed charges billed on the latest statement times those days divided by 30. At 30 days or more no proration applies under this rule. A prorated figure is rounded half up to the cent.

## Terms

- **Days from the latest water read to the service end date**: the service end date less the date of the latest water read on the account.
- **Fixed charges billed on the latest statement**: the fixed charges dated fewer than one whole month before the handling date, taken together.
- **Days in the read cycle that statement billed**: the number of days in the read cycle the latest statement covered.

## Tiers

| Days from the latest water read to the service end date | Fixed charges quoted for the final cycle |
|---|---|
| fewer than 15 (1 to 14) | Latest statement's fixed charges times the days, divided by the days in that statement's read cycle |
| 15 to 29 | Latest statement's fixed charges times the days, divided by 30 |
| 30 or more | no proration under this rule |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: latest statement's fixed charges 42.42; its read cycle 31 days)

| Days | Working | Fixed charges quoted |
|---|---|---|
| 10 | 42.42 times 10, divided by 31, is 13.6839 | 13.68 |
| 14 | 42.42 times 14, divided by 31, is 19.1574 | 19.16 |
| 15 | 42.42 times 15, divided by 30, is 21.21 | 21.21 |
| 29 | 42.42 times 29, divided by 30, is 41.006 | 41.01 |
